documents.description:
AFTER scrim-threshold-forced-container-control merges. AFTER spd-w13-instrument-bucket-precondition merges. AFTER spd-w13-prediction-registered merges. THIS SLICE IS ROUND 2 — do not start it until all three are on origin/main AND guerrilla serves the merge SHA (D47/D63). It must run the GATED instrument against a REGISTERED prediction; a prediction committed after the run it governs is worthless, and an ungated instrument cannot honestly stamp criterion 4.

CLAIM FIRST: `bp task claim inspector-shape-bracketed-deployed-run <worker>`. pr-task-gate hard-fails a PR whose task is still `open`.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU PLAN: THE ROUND TRIP HAS ALREADY BEEN RUN AND IT PASSES (charter D182). Four full sweeps were fired against bc64d869a / slot blue. Three of them (the fourth drew a known flake) each returned cells 27, identical_cells 27, returns_bit_identical TRUE, across all 9 widths x 3 faces, with the non-identical triple list EMPTY. Determinism: 0 cell diffs between runs, 0 matrix field diffs. YOUR JOB IS NOT TO DISCOVER THIS — it is to commit the artefact from the FINAL instrument against the REGISTERED prediction, and to write the bracket. Do not report a re-derivation as a finding.

THE RUN RECIPE, and every clause is bought with a real failure:
- Fire WITHOUT --positive-control (charter D188). The shipped flag is a proven FALSE GREEN: its literal rule flips ::after from none to "" on a fixture with the 860px generator deleted entirely. Quote P's forced-container control as a SIBLING section, never as a desk row. The honest zero_cause on this build is DESK-FIXED (unproven) — .editor-with-preview present in 54/54 hit-tested rows, the scrim rendering in 0 of them.
- DO NOT GATE ON THE EXIT CODE (charter D184). A failed open leg abandons all 27 cells and STILL EXITS 0 — the skip is a returned value, not a throw, so writeRunArtifact runs and the process exits clean. Gate on `round_trip.ran === true && returns_bit_identical === true`. The open leg flaked once in four runs at 1440; D138 permits bounded retries on exactly this. The COMMITTED artefact must be one where ran is true.
- ssh-read the served sha and active slot PRE and POST. A mid-run deploy VOIDS the run.
- Determinism is run-1 vs run-2 of the SAME build. NEVER compare against the committed 2026-07-20 baselines: they are at 65541e2d4, now 71 commits behind (recompute it, do not quote a fixed number) and predating both the ladder and the return grammar.
- Covered-column rows report visible_meets_55ch as NULL, never FALSE. Expect exactly 54 rows with exactly 18 carrying is_destination.

THE BRACKET IS THE DELIVERABLE, and it is per-condition rows, not a paragraph. Answer D161's three conditions EXPLICITLY as (i)/(ii)/(iii) — the lettering D127(a)/(b)/(c) is BANNED by D161 and must not appear. Rule each PAID / partial / not, and rule the exemption as a whole.
- (i) round-trip fidelity — PAID; quote the 27/27 and the empty non-identical list.
- (ii) the exit is cheap, plural and visible — quote the PER-WIDTH dismiss table, NEVER the run-level dismiss_control scalar. That scalar reads widths[0] only and says "toggle re-click — the only dismissal deployed today", which is false about the six destination widths, all of which dismiss via the purpose-built [data-test-id="sidebar-dismiss"] (charter D183).
- (iii) the mode declares itself — no scrim in any row.
ALSO CARRY, as named rows: the three 1024 position:static warnings as the ladder's CONFIRMING rows, not as drift (charter D186); browser-Back-leaves-the-desk as a CONFIRMING row only — it is ALREADY RULED by D179 and is not re-litigated here; and D175's compound secondary-pane state DECLARED OUT-OF-MATRIX IN WORDS (charter D187) — the instrument has no driver path to it, and silence there would let the artefact read as "no scrim renders anywhere post-ladder", which is demonstrably false.

--- ORIGINAL BRIEF BELOW, UNCHANGED ---

AFTER tier3-keyboard-exit-and-focus-return, spd-instrument-open-leg-stale-locator AND scrim-threshold-forced-container-control merge AND the result is DEPLOYED. This slice is ROUND 3.

THIS IS THE WAVE'S DELIVERABLE, NOT ITS EPILOGUE. It is the only artefact permitted to speak about the deployed render, and the only thing converting D127's pre-registered exemption from registered to PAID.

DO NOT TRUST THIS TASK'S OWN OLD TEXT. It claims the positive control is "ALREADY BUILT ... merged in #4924". What shipped in #4924 is the pre-D170 scrim-force control, a different mechanism that passes on a fixture with no generator at all. A builder trusting that line satisfies the wrong guard. The real control is the forced-container script from scrim-threshold-forced-container-control - run it, quote it.

PRECONDITIONS, ALL OF WHICH MUST HOLD BEFORE A SINGLE CELL IS QUOTED:
  1. The three instrument defects are merged and deployed (open-leg locator, derived destination, the 1024 threshold) - charter D177/D178.
  2. The forced-container control runs and FAILS on a generator-deleted fixture - charter D176.
  3. Every reading asserts data-width-bucket equals the expected bucket as a PRECONDITION of the reading (D171: the bucket stamp has a +32px WIDEN-ONLY dead-band, so a page widened to 1280 stamps standard; any no-reload sweep arriving from below tests the wrong tier while passing).

DO NOT ROW-COMPARE AGAINST THE COMMITTED BASELINES. Both scripts/measurements/spd-visible-table-2026-07-20.json and its -verify twin were taken at served_sha 65541e2d4, which is 61 commits behind origin/main and predates BOTH the Tier-2 ladder (#4922) and the Tier-3 return grammar (#5014) - proven with git merge-base --is-ancestor. A fresh run compared to them reports DIVERGENT by construction and that verdict means nothing. Their guard schema is older too (4 keys where the current summariseNonVacuity emits 9), so header diffs are guaranteed. THE DETERMINISM CLAIM (D138) MUST BE RUN-1 VS RUN-2 OF THE SAME BUILD. The baselines are a historical record, not a comparand.

THE NON-VACUITY GUARD IS SOUND AND FALSIFIABLE - this was proven, so do not re-litigate it. Mutating its own predicate flips it: applies=21 passed=21 vacuous=false at baseline; forcing guard_applies false gives applies=0 vacuous=true with zero_cause "DESK-FIXED (unproven)"; forcing host-absent gives "GUARD-NEVER-RAN (instrument suspect)". It distinguishes the two zeros rather than reporting one undifferentiated 0. But note studio-desk-compare.mjs does NOT compute vacuity - it copies three scalars out of the artifact (:216-218), so corrupting rows can never flip a stored scalar.

D153 IS AMENDED AND YOU MUST NOT TRIP OVER THE OLD WORDING (charter D176). D153 said a run is INVALID unless >0 rows in the SAME run render a scrim. Post-ladder that is unsatisfiable from real rows: every reachable cell either lifts the panel clear of 860 or is suppressed. Satisfy it with the FORCED-CONTAINER control instead, executed offline, and NEVER quote that control as a desk row. A guard that reports 0 applies must be read through zero_cause, not celebrated.

STANDING LAW, EACH BOUGHT WITH A REAL FAILURE - no exceptions:
  - Register the prediction BEFORE the run, so it can fail.
  - Every ch figure names its face, font-size and probe-derived px/ch. CROSS-FACE DIVISION IS BANNED. The corrected comparable is 340px = 34.00ch on the native face at 10.0000 px/ch; the 420px/~42ch figure is STRUCK.
  - Measure visible_meets_55ch, NEVER content_meets_55ch.
  - "viewport 640" and "content 640" never appear bare.
  - Prove the non-vacuity guard applies in >0 rows before quoting any cell.
  - A ZERO-BYTE run is an INSTRUMENT FAILURE, never a desk fact.

REPORT AS A BRACKET, NOT A VERDICT. Per-condition rows, so a partial landing still yields an honest quotable ruling rather than one collapsed pass/fail. The three faces all render at 18px, so each face's ch is its own probe figure: native (Iowan Old Style) 10.0000 px/ch -> 55ch = 550.00px; georgia 11.0469 -> 607.58px; source-serif-4 9.1719 -> 504.45px.

THE HIGHEST-INFORMATION BRACKET is user-opened at 1024 (standard). At the old served_sha this row was a LIVE painted scrim: panel_px 720, scrim.renders TRUE, alpha 0.55, dimmed_content_px 378.958. Post-ladder the prediction is panel >= 980, scrim.renders FALSE, guard_applies FALSE. If the scrim still renders there, the wave's Move-4 reasoning is wrong and the standard residue is real - report that as the finding rather than smoothing it.

THE ROWS WHERE THE DESTINATION COVERS THE COLUMN report visible_meets_55ch as NULL, never FALSE. If they come back FALSE that is an instrument defect and it is the run's finding, not a desk fact.

IF THE INSTRUMENT CANNOT CLEAR ITS OWN PRECONDITIONS, REPORT THAT AS THE WAVE'S FINDING rather than manufacturing a desk fact from a broken probe.
